title: Dad Spoke First
description:
It was a Sunday evening call.

Dad brought it up himself.

'Minjun-ah. Last time you asked how I was doing — really asked.'

A pause.

'That meant something.'

choices.result_text:
'...Yeah.'

Not many words. But this call was different.
Asking a little more the last time had come back around like this.

{name} hung up and sat still for a while.

choices.text: "Don't mention it. I was just curious."
choices.result_text:
Dad laughed. Quietly.

'A father knows what's behind the "just curious," son.'

That line stayed longer than expected.

title: The Kid Who Came In
description:
Dad's first appointment after the fall.

The doctor looked up at {name}.
'Oh — you've been in before, right? About the blood pressure medication.'

Dad glanced over.

choices.result_text:
Dad didn't say anything.
Just turned toward the window.

On the way home, he spoke.
'...I remembered. That you came in about the medication.'

Dad nodded. Didn't push.

But no one wanders into their father's specific hospital by accident.
He probably knew that too.

title: The Signal That Was Missed
description:
The first call after Dad's collapse.

His voice was still calm.

'Minjun-ah. You got your mother's message, didn't you — about starting the medication.'

{name} paused before answering.

choices.text: "I should have called then. I'm sorry."
choices.result_text:
'It's fine,' Dad said.
'I knew you were busy.'

Whether that 'it's fine' was real — {name} thought about it for a long time.

choices.text: "I didn't know it was serious. I thought it was minor."
choices.result_text:
'Right.'
Dad ended it with that one word.

{name} stared at the phone after hanging up.
There was something that should have been noticed then.

title: You Came
description:
A late call.

Dad paused before speaking.

'Minjun-ah. That time — you took the train from Seoul in the middle of the night.'

{name} held their breath.

choices.result_text:
'...A father knows what that means.'

A short silence.

'Thank you, Minjun-ah.'

The words stayed. That predawn KTX turned out to have meant something — confirmed for the first time.

choices.text: "I ran because it was you, Dad."
choices.result_text:
Dad laughed softly.

'Right. Because of me.'

A call that had seemed about to end awkwardly found its warmth in that one laugh.
